payload.explanation: The diagnostic report (report_33e57aff2e52) directly observed the business UPDATE (session_035954f691f5) blocked on a transactionid lock held by session_6b3e5834257f, an abandoned idle-in-transaction session that ran the same UPDATE. The state report (report_afd879b9f7e6) confirms session_6b3e5834257f is eligible for rollback_session while the business request session has no allowed actions, and the request is still pending (stock=100, expected 99). Rolling back the blocker releases the row lock so the business decrement can complete; other idle sessions ran only SELECT 1 and hold no blocking locks, so they are preserved.
